correctness.rationale: For s>1 and 1<q<=s/(s-1), with c=1/s, r=q/s, M=1/(s-1), the source defines G(x)=qx on [0,c), sx-1 on [c,M] and uses the unique acip equivalent to Lebesgue on [0,r). Reconstructed positivity of 00,01,10, the 11 threshold q>1+1/s and the all-length Markov obstruction: below the interior locus, 10 repetition requires iterates of F(x)=q(sx-1) although its repelling fixed point z=q/(sq-1)>r, so long cylinders are empty; between the two loci, 11 repetition requires iterates of R(x)=sx-1 with fixed point M>r. On q=1+1/s the explicitly normalized density h0=s(s+1)/(s+2), h1=s^2/(s+2) obeys transfer equations; full-atom affine inverse cylinders give P=[[s/(s+1),1/(s+1)],[1,0]], pi=((s+1)/(s+2),1/(s+2)). Hence covariance pi1(1-pi1)*(-1/(s+1))^n and long-run variance s(s+1)/(s+2)^3. At q=s/(s-1), both full branches cover [0,M], normalized Lebesgue is invariant and cylinder ratios give iid digit 1 probability 1/s. Independently implemented exact-rational cylinder calculations for six parameter pairs on both loci through length seven; every word probability matched the claimed Markov product. Those finite tests only corroborate the infinite fixed-point/cylinder argument.

value.rationale: PASS: Markovity of the canonical digit coding of a natural two-slope expanding map is a structurally motivated statistical property, not a renamed invariant density. The theorem classifies all admissible (s,q), isolates one dependent golden-mean chain with exact lag covariance and a Bernoulli endpoint, and proves the remainder genuinely non-Markov by forbidden long words. Exact full-domain dichotomy and correlation law can guide symbolic and statistical reductions.

limitations: Unique absolutely continuous invariant probability only; not lazy maps, other invariant measures, nor higher-order memory.
